messages:
lee: Noticed a pattern: invoice-preview shows token counts higher than final invoice for tenants behind the new route-priority router. Numbers cluster around hourly watermark boundaries.
hana: Yep, saw it too. It looks like preview is reading the pre-fanout stream and final invoice reads post-aggregator. Fanout duplicates during route handover inflate preview.
devon: Repro steps I used: 1) enable route-priority=beta for tenant; 2) send a burst of streaming requests with identical session_id but new fingerprint; 3) watch preview stream -> duplicates; final invoice deduped later.
maria: That explains refund spikes Finance pinged about. Preview is used by SREs and customers to detect issues; having it higher than invoice is confusing.
lee: Root cause seems to be the aggregator watermark logic. pre-agg window emits on arrival and the post-agg dedupe uses event_watermark which advances on commit. During shard handover we end up with two arrivals for the same logical request across different shards.
ops-bot: router: detected shard-handover events=18 in last 2h; affected_regions=[us-west, eu-west]; probable_cause=assignment_service_reassign.
hana: Two possible fixes: A) change preview pipeline to use the same watermark/dedupe as final (more accurate but higher latency for preview); B) mark preview as "optimistic" and add UI annotation + delta by tenant. Thoughts?
devon: I don't love just annotating, ops will still alert on preview. If we can keep preview latency < 5s we should converge logic. Maybe we can copy aggregator dedupe into the preview path but run it in approximate mode (fast in-memory window keyed by request_id+fingerprint).
maria: Also need auditability: finance wants an immutable audit trail linking preview rows to final invoice rows. Can we include a preview_trace_id in both streams so we can map?
lee: Good call. Proposal: 1) add preview_trace_id stamped by ingress router; 2) preview pipeline dedupe by request_id+fingerprint+short_epoch (200ms); 3) final aggregator keeps strong dedupe; 4) expose "preview_delta" metric per tenant and route.
hana: Risk: adding trace_id is a schema change. We'll default to null for older events. We should version it as meta.preview_trace.v1. Also add a feature flag for enabling preview dedupe so we can rollback quickly.
devon: Metric thresholds: alert if preview_delta_rate > 0.01 for any tenant over 5m OR total preview_delta_tokens > 1000 for prod tenants. Also add smoke tests in canary that simulate shard handover.
maria: Ops playbook: when alert fires, set route-priority back to stable for affected tenants and run hydra-reconcile on assignment service. Finance: we'll prepare credit guidance if invoice deltas exceed preview deltas historically.
lee: Timeline: small preview-pipeline change (devon) -> canary on 5 tenants in eu-west today; add preview_trace_id spec (hana) -> PR by EOD; metrics + dashboard card (maria) -> 1h.
hana: SQL to map preview to invoice for audits (will paste in PR):
```sql
SELECT p.request_id, p.preview_trace_id, i.invoice_id, i.tokens
FROM preview_events p
LEFT JOIN invoice_events i ON p.request_id = i.request_id OR p.preview_trace_id = i.preview_trace_id
WHERE p.tenant_id IN (/* sample tenants */)
ORDER BY p.event_time DESC
```
devon: I'll scope the preview dedupe function as an in-memory streaming operator with a TTL of 2s to avoid long windows. Should be cheap.
maria: One more ask: add a dashboard toggle to switch preview mode between "optimistic" and "aligned" so Support can flip it per-tenant while we roll this out.
lee: Agreed. Let's keep communication tight with Finance and Support. I'll open the infra ticket referencing assignment_service logs and tag @oncall-sre.
ops-bot: ticket-created: ENG-5402 'preview-invoice-watermark-fanout-delta' assigned_to=[lee], priority=high
hana: ok pushing the schema draft now. Will ping when PR is up.
devon: I'll start the preview dedupe branch and post a draft PR in ~30m.
maria: I'll build the dashboard card and alert rule. Finance webhook contact: finance-alerts@redwood.ai
lee: Thanks team. Quick reminder: keep the preview label visible in the UI so customers know it's an estimate until we finish aligning logic.
